environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running Ubuntu 22.04 with the Flask monolith deployed directly via systemd. Application listens on port 8080, fronted by nginx reverse proxy on port 443 with TLS termination. No additional middleware or authorization layer. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. IAM instance profile has S3 read access for config. No container runtime involved - bare metal deployment.
